| spellname = Wrath of the Elements
| spellicon = M
| description = Surrounds your target in an elemental maelstrom, causing 350 damage initially, and between 122 and 132 damage every 6 seconds for 30 secs (5 ticks).

If it lasts the entire duration it will deal an average of 350 + 127 * 5 = 985 (max 1010).  Given the spell's cost that adds up to a 985/265 = 3.72 average damage per mana (DPM).

Does not stack with [[Deadly Velium Poison]].
